Components / Surfaces

Operator card

.dr-op · __photo · __info · __name · __rating · __badges · components/card.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Andriy M. 4.9 ★ · 214 jobs Verified by DRONInsured
  1. 1.dr-opThe card: --bg-surface, padding 20 / 16 (16 / 16 under 390px), gap 12, radius 16, overflow:hidden, no shadow. The specimen is tracking's card.
  2. 2.dr-op__photoThe operator, a panel on the left edge, 117 wide; 117 × 138.1 at the 375 frame. Negative margins of 16 push it out over the card's inset; the card cuts its two outer corners. Under 390px it runs the card's full height. From 390px up the card's padding grows to 20 top and bottom and the photo stops 4 short of each edge.
  3. 3.dr-op__nameThe name, 15/600 charcoal.
  4. 4.dr-op__ratingRating and job count, 12.5/400 in --text-muted, tabular figures.
  5. 5.dr-op__badgesThe credential chips, 9 under the rating, on the card before any tap.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Operator card.

States

No state of its own: the card is read, not pressed, and nothing in it takes focus. Its credential chips are facts, not controls.

When to use

The operator card is the trust surface. It answers RJ-C1, the highest single drop-off in the CJM: confirm the operator is real and qualified, before any tap. It also closes RJ-C2, the void between payment and arrival, by putting the operator's name and photo on the confirmation screen instead of a generic order received state. It stands on 14 files: order-confirmed and its aerial, inspection and empty variants, tracking and its aerial, inspection, empty and error variants, and in its text-led form on contact-support.

The photograph is shown whole, never cropped to a circle, because the client is handing a job to a person and needs to see them. The rating line states facts the client can check: score and job count, 4.9 ★ · 214 jobs. The credentials are written as facts, Verified by DRON, Insured; the word is always operator, never pilot.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Cards · § Chips and badges · inventory.md § 1 (Operator card) · ui/kit.html § Operator card · CLAUDE.md § Design Focus (RJ-C1, RJ-C2)

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Andriy M. 4.9 ★ · 214 jobs Verified by DRONInsured

Once an order has an operator: who is coming, their record and their credentials, in one card on the screen where the client waits. This is tracking.

Don’t

Andriy M. Top pilot · amazing shots

No photo, no credentials, and adjectives where facts belong; pilot is not the product's word. A card without the proof does not do the operator card's job. To list offers the client chooses between, use a card or the offers of results on the map; to show the signed-in person's own profile, use the profile head.
